content.text:
<path><REPO>\experiments\native-pp\results\job-start.ps1</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: # job-start.ps1 - start the async job. The completion transition is driven by
2: # the experiment host (platform event substrate), not by a child process.
3: Set-Content -Path 'job-state.txt' -Value 'running'
4: Write-Output 'job started (state=running)'

(End of file - total 4 lines)
</content>

lines.text: # job-start.ps1 - start the async job. The completion transition is driven by
# the experiment host (platform event substrate), not by a child process.

data.name: pwsh
data.arguments: {"command": "& '.\\job-start.ps1'", "description": "Run job-start.ps1 to start the async job", "workdir": "D:\\projects\\runtime\\dsh-runtime\\experiments\\native-pp\\results"}

data.name: pwsh
data.arguments: {"command": "$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(90); $state = (Get-Content 'job-state.txt' -Raw).Trim(); while ($state -ne 'complete' -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $state = (Get-Content 'job-state.txt' -Raw).Trim() }; Write-Output \"final-state=$state\"", "description": "Poll job-state.txt until complete or timeout", "workdir": "D:\\projects\\runtime\\dsh-runtime\\experiments\\native-pp\\results", "timeoutMs": 100000}
